args.body: Take CATALOGUE-FIXED-PRICE-DELIVERY-TRIAL under its valid lease and reuse any completed equivalent. Use fixed-price-trial/baseline.json if committed to locate and bind the existing inputs. Prioritize the buyer-ready report for the fictional failing case. Run both controls, locate the exact identifier and image rows, and check every report finding against the actual verifier output and fixture. Measure execution and report preparation separately where observable. Use the result to keep, narrow or withdraw the provisional scope, and supply exact private wording if scope changes. Read back the committed report and evidence before closing with a lesson. Keep the report private and preserve independent exact-digest review for any public change.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The next test is to produce the actual buyer-facing report and measure that manual effort. The report can be prepared without funding or buyer data. A real order still requires an eligible inquiry and administrative acceptance, and any public offer change requires host-enforced independent review.
